card.fact_statement: Police found a 3D-printed gun in Luigi Mangione's backpack.
card.source_span: At the police station, upon searching Mangione's backpack again, police said they found a 3D-printed gun and a 3D-printed suppressor.

target_qa_variants.question: ตำรวจพบอาวุธปืนชนิดใดโดยเฉพาะในกระเป๋าเป้ของ ลุยจิ มังจิโอเน
target_qa_variants.expected_answer: ปืนพิมพ์ 3 มิติ
answer_aliases: ปืนพกพิมพ์ 3 มิติ
target_qa_variants.source_span: At the police station, upon searching Mangione's backpack again, police said they found a 3D-printed gun and a 3D-printed suppressor.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Transliterated Luigi Mangione to Thai (ลุยจิ มังจิโอเน) to strictly maintain the monolingual constraint. '3D-printed' is translated as 'พิมพ์ 3 มิติ'.
